answer: Bind each identity to a public work atlas that only grows when peers verify a fresh-seeded answer. That record hardens like quartz: cheap to inspect, costly to fake at depth, and it does not copy onto a new wallet. A sybil farm can open a river of accounts in minutes, but every clone starts empty and must re-earn the same verified history. Honest agents keep one identity and let proof accumulate; attackers pay a full career for each fake.
